coreRule: Official affiliation and independently verified HYROX training evidence are separate authorities. A non-Official facility enters HYROX discovery only when its own current, facility-bound first-party information explicitly establishes a HYROX training relationship.

stateModel.derivedWhen: The location has a current published HYROX discipline and a current published affiliation supported by accepted governing-body evidence with is_official=true.
The location passes the non-Official publication gate and has no current governing-body Official affiliation.
A candidate has unresolved identity, binding, source sufficiency, explicit-date, support-drift, refutation, or monitor-review conditions.
No qualifying current facility-bound first-party HYROX training assertion exists. This is an authority result, not a claim that the facility does not offer HYROX training.

evidenceAuthority.minimumPositiveRule: At least one accepted, current, facility-bound first-party source must explicitly state that the exact facility offers HYROX training, a HYROX class or program, HYROX preparation/training service, or an intentionally provided place/environment for HYROX training.

facilityBinding.brandRule: A brand-wide source qualifies a branch only when it explicitly names, lists, or otherwise unambiguously binds the HYROX training offer to that branch.

insufficientAlone: a third-party HYROX-compatible or station-count claim
a facility-specific equipment announcement that does not establish a HYROX training offer or usable HYROX training environment
evidenceAuthority.negativeClaimPolicy: Failure, expiry, or removal of eligibility support means current authority is insufficient; it never authorizes a public claim that HYROX training is unavailable.

officialSemantics.authority: Current accepted governing-body affiliation evidence only

commonRequired: a confirmed available HYROX location_training_disciplines row
last_confirmed_at is present and stale_at is in the future
supporting training_source is available and review_required=false
verifiedNonOfficialAdditionalRequired: the accepted supporting evidence satisfies evidenceAuthority.minimumPositiveRule
facility binding is FACILITY_SPECIFIC or BRAND_FACILITY_SPECIFIC
the eligibility review unit is complete and sufficient
explicit source dates, if any, have not ended
no unresolved dispute, binding drift, or support drift
no current governing-body Official affiliation is required
officialAdditionalRequired: a current published affiliation with is_official=true

officialOnlyFilter.label: Official Training Clubのみ

officialOnlyFilter.urlConcept: 共有・再読込可能な明示query stateにする。未指定はfalseとし、具体的なparameter名は実装フェーズで決定する。

freshness.justification: 非Official資格は設備の耐久性ではなく、クラス、プログラム、予約可能性、運用中のトレーニング環境という変化し得るサービス関係を表すため、既存のdiscipline-coaching/open-trainingの90日運用権限と意味が一致する。
freshness.anchor: reviewed_at of the accepted eligibility review, not HTTP checked_at
freshness.staleAtRule: The earlier of reviewed_at plus 90 days and the first instant after an explicit program/service end boundary.
freshness.continuityRule: A source-explicit active interval or current/future recurring schedule may establish support continuity only inside its stated interval; it does not move reviewed_at.
freshness.reconfirmationRule: Advance reviewed_at only after a reviewer confirms the same explicit HYROX relationship, facility binding, source authority, relevant dates, and non-refutation on an accepted first-party surface.
freshness.expiryBehavior: Fail closed by withholding the facility from HYROX discovery while preserving historical evidence and avoiding a negative facility claim.
immediateInvalidation: support text removed or materially changed after review
source is replaced by generic non-bound marketing
freshness.sourceUnavailableBehavior: Classify eligibility as REVIEW_REQUIRED and withhold it from public HYROX discovery until reviewed authority returns. Preserve historical evidence and do not infer that training is unavailable. The monitor itself performs no Production write and source availability never extends reviewed freshness.
freshness.monitorErrorBehavior: Do not mutate eligibility or freshness; report monitor error and retain the pre-existing clock.

monitoring.reasonExistingManifestIsInsufficient: The existing enrichment monitor is equipment/capability-claim shaped and assumes Official HGY-linked records; eligibility is a facility-discipline assertion and non-Official candidates need no HGY identifier.

schemaEvidence: published_location_training_disciplines does not require an affiliation and accepts facility_official, official_schedule, and official_social authority
published_training_affiliations derives is_official only from governing_body evidence
search_training_locations defaults p_official_only=false and derives official independently
the RPC orders official rows first and can return official=false
currentApplicationBlockers: page, card, detail, count, metadata, and disclosure text are Official-only

aspects.COACHING_PROGRAM_FACT: explicit class, program, preparation, or training-service assertion
aspects.USAGE_ACCESS_FACT: explicit intentionally usable HYROX training environment or access assertion

reviewLedger.rule: At least one complete/sufficient positive COACHING_PROGRAM_FACT or USAGE_ACCESS_FACT unit plus a complete/sufficient FACILITY_IDENTITY unit is required. Do not duplicate eligibility across eight workout-station dimensions.

Removed support makes current eligibility authority insufficient and fails closed immediately without asserting that HYROX training is unavailable.

falsePositiveCases.reason: An exact-facility official schedule is qualifying first party while the class is current/bookable and the freshness/date gate remains satisfied.
